research_question: Does the frozen vision-step80 outcome score retain association with final outcome after controlling privileged object-stage progress within unseen preset initial states?

identity.task_description: pick up the black bowl from the top drawer of the wooden cabinet and place it on the plate
identity.policy: frozen SmolVLA checkpoint used by v0.1 and v0.2

sampling.selection_rule: collect every declared episode; do not stop, extend, or exclude based on outcomes

information_boundary.predictor: unchanged frozen v0.1 model; scene poses never enter predictor or normalization

stage_variables.target_object: At episode start, select the black-bowl body closest in XY to wooden_cabinet_1_top_region; expected name is akita_black_bowl_1_main.
continuous_controls: target-bowl displacement from its episode start pose
target-bowl height relative to its episode start height
target-bowl XY and 3D distance to plate
top-drawer displacement from its episode start pose
event_alignment: first target-bowl height increase exceeding 0.04 m
first target-bowl XY distance to plate below 0.10 m
stage_variables.threshold_policy: fixed here before outcome inspection; report event reach coverage and never discard trajectories that do not reach an event

evaluation.primary_model: frozen dual-camera vision predictor evaluated at step 80
evaluation.secondary_model: frozen temporal MLP evaluated at step 120
evaluation.primary_test: vision risk versus outcome after controlling continuous object-stage variables, with initial_state_id-cluster bootstrap
evaluation.matched_analysis: compare success/failure runs from the same initial_state_id at the closest object-stage state
evaluation.claim_limit: Outcome association beyond measured task stage; never call it impending-failure detection without an independently defined future unsafe event.
